widget-config.//14: on this box — pavucontrol, wlogout, swappy and hyprpicker are NOT,

widget-config.//20: These two sliders do NOT hit the bug that killed waybar's in-bar
widget-config.//21: sliders. That was waybar's ASlider calling set_value() on the very
widget-config.//22: widget under the pointer with no drag interlock (see the WHY THIS
widget-config.//23: EXISTS block in config/sway/sway-quickpanel). swaync drives a plain
widget-config.//24: GtkScale and does not write back mid-drag, so dragging is precise.
widget-config.//25: sway-quickpanel therefore still exists but is no longer the only
widget-config.//26: way to drag these — it stays because it is one keystroke away and

widget-config.//32: ⚠ `min` IS THE WHOLE REASON THIS WIDGET IS SAFE TO ENABLE. Without
widget-config.//33: it swaync writes the raw sysfs percent straight through, so dragging
widget-config.//34: to the bottom takes the panel fully black — the one thing the floor
widget-config.//35: exists to prevent, and hard to undo when you cannot see the screen.
widget-config.//36: With it, `slider.set_range(min, 100)` makes the bottom of the track
widget-config.//37: unreachable below 5 — the SAME model sway-quickpanel uses (its scale
widget-config.//38: is also real units clamped at BRIGHTNESS_MIN, with the 0-100 user
widget-config.//39: scale applied only to the label). 5 must match BRIGHTNESS_MIN in
widget-config.//40: sway-quickpanel and FLOOR in sway-brightness — three copies, change
widget-config.//41: all three together or the slider and the keys disagree about the
widget-config.//43: AND THE FALSE ZERO COMES FREE WITH IT — this was not obvious and is
widget-config.//44: worth not re-deriving. `min` moves the GtkAdjustment's LOWER bound,
widget-config.//45: not just a clamp on writes, and GtkScale places the handle at
widget-config.//46: (value - lower) / (upper - lower). So the track itself becomes the
widget-config.//47: user scale: hard left IS real 5%, hard right is 100%, linear between
widget-config.//48: — algebraically the same map as FLOOR + user*(100-FLOOR)/100 in
widget-config.//49: sway-brightness. Measured, not assumed: with the hardware forced to
widget-config.//50: 3% the handle clamps to lower and lands at x=1501, the exact pixel
widget-config.//51: where the volume slider (range 0..100) sits at 0.
widget-config.//52: The one thing left un-remapped is the DRAG TOOLTIP, which prints the
widget-config.//53: real percent (5..100). Nothing else shows a number — the widget calls
widget-config.//55: ⚠ DO NOT reach for a newer swaync for that tooltip. Upstream main is
widget-config.//56: identical here apart from the GTK4 port (append vs pack_start): same
widget-config.//57: `min`, same raw write, same real-percent tooltip. Fixing one tooltip
